entry.en: Your passport must expire at least one month after the date you arrive in the Maldives.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe vencer al menos un mes después de la fecha de llegada a Maldivas.
entry.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least one month after the date you arrive in Maldives.

entry.en: A traveller declaration form (IMUGA) must be completed within 96 hours before your flight arrives.
entry.es: Debes completar un formulario de declaración del viajero (IMUGA) en las 96 horas previas a la llegada de tu vuelo.
entry.quote: You must complete a traveller declaration form (IMUGA) within 96 hours before your flight arrives in the Maldives.

entry.en: Tourists receive a 30-day visa on arrival in the Maldives.
entry.es: Los turistas reciben una visa de 30 días a la llegada a Maldivas.
entry.quote: You will get a 30-day visa on arrival if you enter Maldives as a tourist.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país listado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: To enter Maldives, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: It is illegal to bring in anything deemed contrary to Islam, including idols for worship, bibles, pork products and alcohol.
entry.es: Es ilegal introducir cualquier cosa considerada contraria al islam, incluidos ídolos de culto, biblias, productos de cerdo y alcohol.
entry.quote: It is illegal to bring in anything deemed contrary to Islam, including ‘idols for worship’, bibles, pork and pork products, and alcohol.

entry.en: Wikivoyage says arrivals need a confirmed return ticket plus a prepaid hotel booking or proof of funds (US$100 plus $50 per day).
entry.es: Wikivoyage indica que se necesita un billete de vuelta confirmado y una reserva de hotel prepagada o prueba de fondos (100 USD más 50 por día).
entry.quote: a return journey confirmed ticket and entry requirements to the onward destinations, a prepaid confirmed hotel booking at a registered hotel or proof of financial means for sufficient funds to support the stay in Maldives (US$100 + $50 per day).

safety.en: Outside resorts there are incidents of gang-related violence including knife crime, mainly in Malé and Hulhumalé.
safety.es: Fuera de los resorts hay incidentes de violencia de pandillas, incluidos delitos con cuchillo, sobre todo en Malé y Hulhumalé.
safety.quote: Outside the resorts, there are incidents of gang-related violence including knife crime, mainly in Malé and in Hulhumalé. Avoid empty roads when on foot, particularly after dark.

safety.en: FCDO says terrorist attacks in the Maldives cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: El FCDO indica que no se pueden descartar atentados terroristas en Maldivas.
safety.quote: Terrorist attacks in Maldives cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: Alcohol is only available on resort islands, and possessing it or being intoxicated elsewhere can lead to arrest and deportation.
safety.es: El alcohol solo está disponible en islas resort, y poseerlo o estar ebrio fuera de ellas puede acarrear arresto y deportación.
safety.quote: Alcoholic drinks are only available on resort islands. Do not take any alcohol out of your resort. You can be arrested and deported for possessing and drinking alcohol, or being intoxicated outside resorts and on inhabited islands.

safety.en: Same-sex relations are illegal in the Maldives and conviction could bring a fine or a lengthy prison sentence.
safety.es: Las relaciones entre personas del mismo sexo son ilegales en Maldivas y una condena puede acarrear multa o larga pena de prisión.
safety.quote: Same-sex relations are illegal and if you are convicted, you could get a fine or a lengthy prison sentence.

safety.en: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, are serious offences in the Maldives and even small quantities can lead to arrest.
safety.es: Las drogas ilegales, incluido el cannabis, son delitos graves en Maldivas y incluso pequeñas cantidades pueden llevar al arresto.
safety.quote: Possession, trafficking and manufacture of any illegal drugs are serious offences in Maldives and penalties can be severe. This includes cannabis, even small quantities can lead to arrest.

health.en: Medical facilities are limited and the only fully equipped hospitals are in Malé and Hulhumalé.
health.es: Los servicios médicos son limitados y los únicos hospitales completamente equipados están en Malé y Hulhumalé.
health.quote: Medical facilities are limited – the only fully equipped hospitals are in Malé and Hulhumalé.

health.en: Tap water may not be drinkable at all resorts in the Maldives, so enquire locally.
health.es: El agua del grifo puede no ser potable en todos los resorts de Maldivas, así que consulta localmente.
health.quote: Beware that tap water may not be drinkable at all resorts: enquire locally.

health.en: The Maldives are malaria-free, though some islands have mosquitoes and catching dengue is possible but highly unlikely.
health.es: Maldivas está libre de malaria, aunque algunas islas tienen mosquitos y contraer dengue es posible, aunque muy improbable.
health.quote: The Maldives are malaria-free, but some islands do have mosquitoes and catching dengue fever from them is possible, albeit highly unlikely.

health.en: Most resort islands have a doctor or medical facility nearby, but many are several hours from emergency treatment.
health.es: La mayoría de islas resort tienen médico o centro médico cerca, pero muchas están a varias horas de atención de urgencia.
health.quote: Most resort islands are within reach of a doctor or have their own medical facilities, but many are several hours’ travel away from emergency treatment.

help.en: Maldives emergency numbers are ambulance 102, fire 118 and police 119.
help.es: Números de emergencia en Maldivas: ambulancia 102, bomberos 118 y policía 119.

help.en: The tourist police can be contacted at any time on toll-free 1478 or (+960) 9790070.
help.es: La policía turística puede contactarse en cualquier momento en el 1478 gratuito o en el (+960) 9790070.
help.quote: Dial toll-free number 1478 or (+960) 9790070 to contact the tourist police at anytime

help.en: FCDO lists a Ministry of Tourism and Environment hotline at +9609423131.
help.es: El FCDO lista una línea directa del Ministerio de Turismo y Medio Ambiente: +9609423131.
help.quote: Hotline number Ministry of Tourism and Environment: +9609423131

getting_in.en: Practically all visitors arrive at Velana International Airport (MLE) on Hulhulé Island next to Malé.
getting_in.es: Prácticamente todos los visitantes llegan al aeropuerto internacional Velana (MLE), en la isla de Hulhulé junto a Malé.
getting_in.quote: Practically all visitors arrive at Velana International Airport (MLE IATA), on Hulhulé Island next to the capital city Malé.

getting_in.en: Gan Airport (GAN) on Addu atoll serves a few international flights.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Gan (GAN), en el atolón Addu, recibe algunos vuelos internacionales.
getting_in.quote: Gan Airport (GAN IATA), on the southern atoll of Addu, serves a few international flights.

getting_in.en: There are no regular passenger boats to the Maldives.
getting_in.es: No hay barcos regulares de pasajeros hacia Maldivas.
getting_in.quote: There are no regular passenger boats to the Maldives.

getting_around.en: The four main ways of getting around the Maldives are domestic flight, boat, seaplane and liveaboard yacht.
getting_around.es: Las cuatro formas principales de moverse por Maldivas son vuelo doméstico, barco, hidroavión y yate liveaboard.
getting_around.quote: There are four main ways of getting around in the Maldives: domestic flight, boat, seaplane and private yacht (liveaboard).

getting_around.en: Seaplanes prefer not to operate at night, so late arrivals bound for distant resorts may have to overnight in Malé, Hulhumalé or Hulhulé.
getting_around.es: Los hidroaviones prefieren no operar de noche, por lo que quien llegue tarde a un resort lejano quizá deba pasar la noche en Malé, Hulhumalé o Hulhulé.
getting_around.quote: Seaplanes prefer not to operate at night, so if you arrive at the airport after dark and are going to a distant resort, you may have to spend the night in Malé, Hulhumalé or at the airport hotel in Hulhulé.

getting_around.en: Public dhoni ferries and cargo boats are available for independent and budget-conscious travellers.
getting_around.es: Hay ferris públicos dhoni y barcos de carga para viajeros independientes y de presupuesto ajustado.
getting_around.quote: Public dhoni ferries and cargo boats are available for more the independent-minded and budget-conscious.

getting_around.en: The permit system for visiting other islands has been abolished, according to Wikivoyage.
getting_around.es: Según Wikivoyage, se abolió el sistema de permisos para visitar otras islas.
getting_around.quote: The previous system of requiring written invitations and Inter Atoll Travelling Permits (IATP) for those wishing to visit other islands has been abolished

getting_around.en: Seaplane schedules may not be finalized until the previous day and delays are frequent.
getting_around.es: Los horarios de los hidroaviones pueden no estar definidos hasta el día anterior y los retrasos son frecuentes.
getting_around.quote: Plane schedules may not be finalized until the previous day and delays are frequent.

money.en: The local currency is the rufiyaa, but by law resorts price services in US dollars and require hard currency or credit card.
money.es: La moneda local es la rufiyaa, pero por ley los resorts cobran en dólares estadounidenses y exigen divisa fuerte o tarjeta de crédito.
money.quote: The local currency is the Maldivian rufiyaa, denoted by the symbol "Rf" or "MRF" (ISO code: MVR). It is divided into 100 laari. However by law, resorts price services in US dollars and require payment in hard currency (or credit card).

money.en: US dollars are near-universally accepted in the Maldives.
money.es: Los dólares estadounidenses se aceptan casi universalmente en Maldivas.

money.en: Tipping is not compulsory in the Maldives as a 10% service charge is added to everything.
money.es: La propina no es obligatoria en Maldivas, ya que se añade un 10% de cargo por servicio a todo.
money.quote: Tipping is not compulsory in the Maldives as a 10% service charge is added to everything

money.en: To change rufiyaa back to your currency before departure, you need to keep the receipt.
money.es: Para cambiar rufiyaas de vuelta a tu moneda antes de partir, debes conservar el recibo.
money.quote: If you want to change rufiyaa back to your currency before departure, you need to keep the receipt.

etiquette.en: The Maldives is an Islamic country and it is illegal to publicly observe a religion other than Islam.
etiquette.es: Maldivas es un país islámico y es ilegal practicar públicamente una religión distinta del islam.
etiquette.quote: Maldives is an Islamic country. It is illegal to publicly observe a religion other than Islam.

etiquette.en: On local islands, cover your shoulders and avoid short or tight-fitting shorts, for both men and women.
etiquette.es: En islas locales, cúbrete los hombros y evita pantalones cortos o ajustados, tanto hombres como mujeres.
etiquette.quote: You should be sensitive to local dress standards when on local islands or if staying on an island where the resort is not the exclusive property on the island – cover your shoulders and avoid short or tight-fitting shorts (men and women).

etiquette.en: Nudism and topless sunbathing are not allowed anywhere in the Maldives, including resort islands.
etiquette.es: El nudismo y el topless no están permitidos en ningún lugar de Maldivas, incluidas las islas resort.
etiquette.quote: Nudism and topless sunbathing are not allowed anywhere, including on resort islands.

connectivity.en: There are two mobile operators, Dhiraagu and Ooredoo, and both sell prepaid SIM cards or eSIMs.
connectivity.es: Hay dos operadores móviles, Dhiraagu y Ooredoo, y ambos venden SIM de prepago o eSIM.
connectivity.quote: There are two mobile operators: Dhiraagu and Ooredoo. Both sell local prepaid SIM card or eSIM

connectivity.en: Both operators have shops next to the airport arrivals area.
connectivity.es: Ambos operadores tienen tiendas junto a la zona de llegadas del aeropuerto.
connectivity.quote: They both have shops next to the airport arrivals area upon exiting.

connectivity.en: Most hotels and cafés offer public Wi-Fi but connections are usually slow.
connectivity.es: La mayoría de hoteles y cafés ofrecen wifi público, pero las conexiones suelen ser lentas.
connectivity.quote: Most hotels and cafés offer public Wi-Fi but connections are usually slow.
